title: Starter Spells
description:
Some spells you can use relatively early on are the ones that come pre-inscribed in spell books. 

These spells are usually weaker than the ones you can inscribe yourself, but they can still be useful. They are a great way to get a feel for how spell casting works, and they can help you get started with magic. 

Try crafting the Isekai Travel Guidebook and the Explorer's Codex to get some pre-inscribed spell books with a variety of spells to try out.
